executiveAssessment.text: Hotel Caribe by Faranda Grand, a member of Radisson Individuals currently shows AI Consideration of 43.3% and Scenario Presence of 69.8%, with Reality Coverage at 46.2%. Strongest governed signal: Often placed near the top when AI ranks hotels. Primary constraint: Not appearing consistently in AI answers. Versus the prior published run (2026-09-08), material headline movement is AI Consideration +43.3 pp and Scenario Presence +69.8 pp. Independent Positioning shows #1 of 4 with Portfolio AI Presence 43.3%. Independent Positioning is weak as well, so the Core and portfolio reads point in the same direction. Overall Core performance remains weak; gaps are broad across consideration, scenario coverage, and Independent Positioning. Management should prioritize correcting clear visibility and reality gaps, then address the competitors that most often appear when the property is absent.

positiveSignal.title: Positive Signal
positiveSignal.body: Among AI answers where hotel ranking could be measured, Hotel Caribe by Faranda Grand, a member of Radisson Individuals appeared in the Top 3 72.4% of the time. This shows how prominently the hotel is positioned when AI includes it.

secondaryCallout.title: Performance Risk
secondaryCallout.body: The hotel appeared in at least one AI answer for 69.8% of the traveler needs we tested, but across all individual AI answers it appeared 43.3% of the time. In practical terms, AI recognizes the hotel as relevant for many types of trips, but a traveler will not consistently see it among the hotel options surfaced.
